notes.graphics-backend: GameMaker's D3D11 runner probes MSAA support with CheckMultisampleQualityLevels. Under CrossOver's D3DMetal backend four of those calls return E_INVALIDARG (0x80070057), and the runner shows each as a 'Win32 function failed' dialog before it continues. DXVK and DXMT both return a valid result and the game starts without a dialog (measured 2026-10-26, see .planning/todos/pending/2026-10-25-mining-mechs-win32-error-dialogs-on-launch.md).
